content: Ricola AG is a prominent Swiss company specializing in the production of cough drops and breath mints. The company is renowned for its emphasis on utilizing herbal ingredients in its products. History Ricola was established in 1930 by Emil Wilhelm Richterich. As of 2007, the company is managed by Felix Richterich. The name Ricola is derived from the abbreviation of Richterich & Compagnie Laufen. The company’s headquarters are located in the Swiss town of Laufen. Herbs The primary active ingredient in most Ricola products is menthol. However, a significant feature of Ricola’s products is their unique herbal mixture. This mixture includes the following herbs: Elder (Sambucus nigra) Horehound (Marrubium vulgare) Mallow (Malva sylvestris) Peppermint (Mentha × piperita) Sage (Salvia officinalis) Thyme (Thymus vulgaris) Cowslip (Primula veris) Burnet (Pimpinella saxifraga) Yarrow (Achillea millefolium) Marsh Mallow (Althaea officinalis) Lady’s Mantle (Alchemilla vulgaris) Speedwell, also known as Veronica (Veronica officinalis) Plantain (Plantago lanceolata) Hyssop (Hyssopus officinalis) Lemon Balm, also known as Lemon Mint or Melissa (Melissa officinalis) Orange-Mint (Mentha citrata) The first thirteen herbs listed are considered part of Ricola’s classic herbal mixture. However, two additional herbs, Linden Flowers and Wild Thyme, are not mentioned on Ricola’s official website. Business Culture As of 2004, Ricola held assets worth 245 million Swiss Francs and employed approximately 400 workers. Around 200 independent production companies in the surrounding areas supply Ricola with resources. To ensure a sufficient supply of herbs for their herbal drops, Ricola also maintains five private herbal gardens located in Zermatt, Kandersteg, Pontresina, and Nenzlingen. The company is widely recognized for its commercials featuring mountaineers shouting Ri-co-la. while playing a large Alphorn. Products Ricola offers a diverse range of products with various flavors. These include: Cough Drops: Original Herb Honey Lemon with Echinacea Orange Spice with Echinacea Sugar-Free Cough Drops: Sugar-Free Mountain Herb Sugar-Free Green Tea with Echinacea Throat Drops: Lemon Mint Cherry Honey Honey Herb Sugar-Free Throat Drops: Sugar-Free Lemon Mint Sugar-Free Cherry Nature’s Protection (contains daily value of Vitamin C): Cranberry Elderberry Orange Mint Ricola Refreshers: Lemon Mint Elderflower Ricola Breath Mints: Spearmint Peppermint Lemon Mint Ricola Herb Gardens Ricola actively promotes the cultivation of natural herbal gardens in the Swiss mountain regions, emphasizing sustainable and environmentally friendly practices.
